2.context: So what makes oneness Pentecostals more like Mormons and Jehovah's Witnesses than like Methodists, evangelicals, or other Protestants? The answer is their Trinitarian heresy, which invalidates the baptism they claim to celebrate. Jesus said to make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. But oneness Pentecostals believe that the name of God just is Jesus. According to them, the terms Father, Son, and Holy Spirit do not refer to three distinct persons, but to three manifestations of God or three roles that God plays in our salvation.
